rows.title: Main import reason and additional details copy matches Design Release 2.1
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 renames the reason page 'Main import reason', opens its destination country and port of exit selects on 'Select one' with no divider line, and rewords the certification hint on the additional details page. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps the reason page's selects as plain selects in this programme. The review keeps the reason answers under 'Main import reason' and the additional details answers as 'Certified for' and 'Includes unweaned animals'. Traders see the same names on the pages and on the review, in English and Welsh.
acceptanceCriteria: The main import reason page's h1 reads 'Main import reason' and its browser title reads 'Main import reason - Import notification service - GOV.UK'; 'Main reason for import' no longer appears on the page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-001; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-002; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-067)

Every 'Destination country' select on the reason page starts with an empty option reading 'Select one', selected when nothing is chosen, followed straight by the places with no divider line (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-042; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-041)

Every 'Port of exit' select on the reason page starts with an empty option reading 'Select one', selected when nothing is chosen, followed straight by the ports with no divider line (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-045; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-041)

Where a reason page select already offers type-ahead search when this row is built, its empty state reads 'Select one' wherever that field can show a placeholder (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-042)

The certification question on the additional details page is hinted 'You can find this information on the ITAHC.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-090; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-066)

The review shows the reason answers under 'Main import reason', with the internal market purpose labelled 'Purpose in the market' and, for Temporary admission horses, 'Exit date' and 'Port of exit' rows (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-042, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-046)
The review shows the additional details answers as 'Certified for' and, where the unweaned question was asked, 'Includes unweaned animals' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-077)

With the language set to Welsh, the reason page's heading and title, both select placeholders and the certification hint show Welsh text in place of the old wording, not English (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-001; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-003)
notes: Combines the heading slice (req-131), the two select placeholder slices (req-145, req-148), the certification hint (req-173) and the review labels (req-183, req-184): all copy on the same two pages and their review rows, reviewed in one sitting. c-029, c-032, c-033 and c-034: the prototype wins by default.

Rewritten for ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm (claims p1-040 to p1-042): the reason page's selects stay plain selects in this programme; the transhipment destination country is not in EUDPA-635 and goes to deferred.md for a follow-on ticket; if EUDPA-635 has already put type-ahead on a transit or temporary admission field when this row builds, 'Select one' is carried as far as that component can show it.

Today 'Purpose in the market', 'Exit date', 'Port of exit', 'Certified for' and 'Includes unweaned animals' are already the review's labels; only the 'Main reason for import' heading of the review's reason block changes, which lives in the review's shared copy. The combiner should merge req-183 and req-184 into the review area's label row if it keeps them apart from this one. The tests repo's import reason page object and spec assert 'Main reason for import' today (repo-tests-p1-067) and change with it.

rows.title: Reason and additional details sit in Design Release 2.1's journey order
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 follows the main import reason with Commodity details, and places Additional details in the commodity section after Identification details (or Commodity details when no identifiers are needed), going on to Arrival details. Both pages' Back links go to the page before them in the journey instead of always to the overview. Opened from the overview, each page still returns to the overview.
acceptanceCriteria: In the linear journey, 'Save and continue' on a valid main import reason page goes to Commodity details (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-033)

The main import reason page's Back link goes to What are you importing in the linear journey (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-007; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-007; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-075)

Opened from the overview, the main import reason page's Back link and its 'Save and continue' both go to the overview (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-008, prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

In the linear journey the additional details page is reached from Identification details when a selected species needs identifiers, and from Commodity details otherwise, never straight from the main import reason page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-059; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-070)

In the linear journey, 'Save and continue' on the additional details page goes to Arrival details; opened from the overview it returns to the overview (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-093; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-071; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-196)

The additional details page's Back link goes to Identification details when any selected species needs identifiers, and to Commodity details otherwise (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-073; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-094, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-096; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-069)

A cattle notification walked from the start through the linear journey visits, in order, What are you importing, Main import reason, Commodity details, Identification details, Additional details and Arrival details (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-070; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p5-061)
rows.gate: Walk the linear journey from What are you importing to Arrival details for a cattle and a horses-only notification, and check both Back links, before rows that rely on the new order build.
notes: Unchanged from the existing row. Combines the reason page's Back and next slices (req-163, req-164) with the additional details page's Back and position slices (req-178, req-179): they are one reorder of the same journey run and its section membership, so building them apart would repeat the flow change and its ladder. The prototype wins c-030, c-031, c-036 and c-037 by default; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim p1-196 confirms an overview-opened page returns to the overview.

Moving Additional details out of the reason's section and after Identification changes the journey's shared flow and run; the commodities area's rows change the same order from the commodity side, and the journey-flow area may own the shared run. Today's fit tests pin both Back links to the overview (repo-frontend-p7-065, repo-frontend-p7-107) and the tests repo's journey flow goes reason then Additional details (repo-tests-p1-075); both change with this row. Depends on inc-001 (the opening run's order) and inc-015 (the commodity pages as journey steps).

rows.title: Main import reason completes on its own answers, and both pages soft-save as Design Release 2.1 does
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 judges the main import reason task on the reason's own answers, with Additional details its own task. 'Save and return to overview' saves what is valid and returns to the overview without the page's required-answer checks, so a trader can leave part-way through. An answer that breaks its own format rule, such as an impossible exit date, is still refused, because the service cannot store it.
acceptanceCriteria: With an allowed reason and its valid follow-ups saved (Internal market with a purpose; Transhipment or onward travel with a listed country; Transit with a listed port and country; Temporary admission horses with a real exit date and a listed port; Re-entry alone), the overview shows the main import reason task as complete while Additional details is still unanswered (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-080, prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-081)
With no reason saved, the overview does not show the main import reason task as complete (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-081)

'Save and return to overview' on the main import reason page with Transit chosen and no port of exit shows no error, goes to the overview, and the reason page then shows Transit chosen with the destination country given (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-075, prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-076; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p4-051)

'Save and return to overview' after changing the reason from Internal market to Transit clears the saved internal market purpose: the reason page shows no purpose when Internal market is chosen again (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-077)
'Save and return to overview' with no reason chosen leaves every earlier saved reason answer as it was (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-079)

'Save and return to overview' with Temporary admission horses chosen and an exit date that is not a real calendar date, such as 31/2/2026, is refused with the exit date's own error and stays on the page (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010)
When amending, the main import reason page's 'Save and return' action saves the same way and goes to the review page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-075)

'Save and return to overview' on the additional details page with both questions unanswered shows no error, goes to the overview, and keeps any earlier answer to each question (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-071)
notes: Unchanged from the existing row. Combines the completion slice (req-168; c-038: the prototype wins, the reason task no longer waits for Additional details) with the two soft-save slices (req-166, req-180): all three are the save and status behaviour of the same two pages, observed on the overview.

c-211 settles 'Save and return to overview': it saves without the required-answer checks, but an answer failing its own format rule, such as an impossible date, is still refused (ruling:sam-2026-10-07). No today source shows what 'Save and return to overview' does on these pages (trace-animals-fit-p7-079, trace-animals-fit-p12-068): the builder reads the shared save actions and changes only what differs. Kept apart from the journey-order row because it changes no route. Depends on inc-003, the shared soft-save foundation.

rows.title: Unweaned question is asked for cattle and pigs
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 asks 'Does the consignment contain any unweaned animals?' of every commodity that carries unweaned options, which is cattle and pig. Today only cattle are asked, and the cattle half already holds. Pig is not in today's five-commodity live-animal catalogue, so this waits with the MDM commodity catalogue that adds it: once pigs can be chosen, a consignment with any pig is asked too; every other commodity still is not.
acceptanceCriteria: A notification with a pig commodity selected sees 'Does the consignment contain any unweaned animals?' on the additional details page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-064; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-095; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-072)
A notification with cattle selected still sees the unweaned question (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-075)

A notification whose commodities are only horses, cats, dogs, poultry or fish sees the certification question and no unweaned question (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-099, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-059)
The review shows 'Includes unweaned animals' for a pig notification once the question is answered (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-077)
openQuestions: Blocked on the MDM commodity integration: the live-animal catalogue that adds pig comes from MDM, and none of today's five commodities is a pig (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims p2-025, p2-026). Whoever lands the MDM commodity catalogue (with inc-012) unblocks this row; the area is re-distilled when it lands.
notes: Was todo; now blocked by ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm (claim p2-025), which has inc-023 wait with the commodity catalogue. Kept apart so the rest of the reason and additional details rows build now. The prototype wins c-035 by default. The unweaned list lives with the commodity catalogue, which the commodities area also changes. Depends on inc-012.

rows.title: Destination country selects offer reference-data's countries and their subdivisions
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 offers places beside the countries as destinations, labelled with their parent country. The 9 October ruling builds this now: the transhipment and transit 'Destination country' selects are built from reference-data's GBNAG_SPS_EX countries plus their subdivisions, as the origin page already is. What the list holds is MDM's to own, so no entry is added, removed or respelt in code, and the list shows whatever reference-data serves in each environment (trade-imports-stub locally and in CDP dev, real MDM in CDP test).
acceptanceCriteria: The transhipment 'Destination country' select offers the same places, countries and their subdivisions, as the country of origin page offers, taken from reference-data's GBNAG_SPS_EX block as served in that environment (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-135, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-145; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-035)
The transit 'Destination country' select offers the same places as the transhipment one (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-135; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p4-106)

Each subdivision in both selects is labelled '<territory> (<parent>)', with the parent country's name as reference-data serves it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-130, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-133)

Countries and subdivisions are listed together in one alphabetical order, as the country of origin page orders them, after the empty placeholder option (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-134)
A subdivision chosen as the destination country saves without an error, and the reason page shows it selected when reopened (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-135)
A destination country saved before this change, from today's 31-country list, is still shown selected when the reason page is reopened (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p7-044)
notes: c-026: the 9 October ruling wins; the list content is reference-data's, never typed into code (req-1766 is out of scope). req-149 (the port of exit list) is already met and is not in this row.

No referencedata change: the frontend already fetches the GBNAG_SPS_EX block with its subdivisions for the origin page; the reason page today offers only the countries, without subdivisions. The criteria name no entry or count, because the list differs by environment.
Ordering need (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim p1-149): builds after the stub tidy-up row at the head of the reference-lists theme (inc-173), which changes the names and counts the tests assert.

Theme: the change sits in the import-reason feature folder, which the commodities-and-reason theme owns, and in the countries service, which reference-lists owns. The combiner should either keep it in reference-lists and give that theme this row's reach, or move it to commodities-and-reason with its dependency on inc-173.

rows.title: Port of exit options read and order like the port of entry list
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 labels each port of exit '<port name> - <port code>', as the port of entry options are labelled, and the 9 October ruling orders the port of exit lists as the port of entry list: airports, then seaports, then rail ports, each A to Z by name. Both lists read the same ports reference data serves, so the order and the label are built once for entry and exit.
acceptanceCriteria: Each 'Port of exit' option, on both the transit and the temporary admission selects, reads '<port name> - <port code>', the same label the port of entry options take, and choosing one still saves the port code (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p1-084; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-035; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p7-037; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p7-045; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p4-108)

Locally, in CDP dev and in CDP test, both 'Port of exit' selects list every airport first, then every seaport, then every rail port (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-165, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-172, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-173, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-174; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p7-046)

Within each group of a 'Port of exit' select, ports are listed A to Z by name ignoring letter case, with non-breaking and doubled spaces compared as single spaces (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-175)
A port of exit saved before this change is still shown selected when the reason page is reopened (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p7-045)
notes: Combines the port of exit label slice (req-1768; c-226, the prototype wins by default) with the port of exit order slice (req-1769): both change the same two selects from the same ports list.

Already sits in inc-007 with the port of entry order (req-304, req-1813, from another area's draft): the order is reference data's and the exit selects read the same list, so building it once for entry and exit avoids repeating the reference-data change and its ladder. The combiner should keep these requirements in inc-007 and merge this draft into it. The type reaches reference data under req-304's work, after the stub tidy-up row (inc-173).

rows.title: Main import reason page edits a template from its review
rows.detail: Design Release 2.1 lets a trader edit a template page by page from the template's review. Template mode is another way of walking the same journey pages, never a copy of them, so later changes to the main import reason page carry into template mode without rework. Opened that way, the page's Back link goes to the template's review, and saving saves the template and returns there with a confirmation. Template mode applies to the animals sets only.
acceptanceCriteria: Opened from a template's review, the main import reason page's Back link goes to that template's review (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-009; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-041)

Opened from a template's review, a valid 'Save and continue' saves the reason to the template and returns to the template's review, showing '<title> has been updated' with the template's title (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-009)
The template's review then shows the reason just saved, and the notification the template came from is unchanged (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-009)

Opened from a template's review, the main import reason page shows the same heading, reasons, follow-up questions and error messages as the notification's main import reason page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-026, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-030)
notes: Rewritten for ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates: template mode walks this same page, never a copy (claims p1-026, p1-029, p1-030), and works on the page as it stands when built rather than waiting for other themes' changes to it (claim p1-031); it is animals only (claim p1-044). Kept apart because it needs the templates area's rows that let a template be reviewed and changed (inc-156, inc-159), or the combiner merges it into the templates row that brings editing to each journey page if that row covers every page. No template mode exists in the real frontend today.

rows.title: Germinal products notifications are certified for 'Germinal products' without being asked
rows.detail: The germinal products set never asks what the goods are certified for: a draft is created with 'Germinal products' already stored, published as the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause like any other certified-for answer, and read back on the review with no Change link.
acceptanceCriteria: A newly created germinal-products notification's review shows an Additional details block with one row, 'Certified for', reading 'Germinal products', before any journey page has been answered (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-079)
The 'Certified for' row of a germinal-products notification's review has no Change link (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-020; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-079)

Submitting a germinal-products notification publishes the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause carrying 'Germinal products', seen in that notification's published event in the admin's outbox view (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019)

A newly created live-animals notification is not certified for anything until the trader answers the certification question: its review shows no 'Germinal products' answer (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)
notes: Already sits in inc-182 (the rest of the germinal journey, with req-1898 and req-1839): its review and published criteria need the germinal review and submit that row builds. The combiner should keep req-182 in inc-182 and merge this draft into it. The backend already stores certified-for as free text and publishes it as the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS clause (req-1590, already met), so no backend change is expected.
